+    static String normalized(String s) {
+        return s.replaceFirst("^Source: ","").replaceFirst("^Sink: ","");

+    static Map<String,Object> topology(StreamGraph graph) {
+        List<Map<String,Object>> nodes=new ArrayList<>();List<Map<String,String>> edges=new ArrayList<>();
+        for(StreamNode node:graph.getStreamNodes()) {
+            Map<String,Object> n=new LinkedHashMap<>();
+            n.put("name",normalized(node.getOperatorName()));n.put("parallelism",node.getParallelism());nodes.add(n);
+            for(StreamEdge edge:node.getOutEdges()) {
+                Map<String,String> e=new LinkedHashMap<>();
+                e.put("from",normalized(node.getOperatorName()));
+                e.put("to",normalized(graph.getStreamNode(edge.getTargetId()).getOperatorName()));
+                edges.add(e);
+            }
         }
+        Map<String,Object> result=new LinkedHashMap<>();result.put("nodes",nodes);result.put("edges",edges);return result;
+    }

-
-        private transient List<ValueState<Long>> states;

-            this.stateNames = stateNames;
-        }

-        public void open(Configuration parameters) throws Exception {

-        @Override
-        public void processElement(
-                ModuleResult value,

-                Collector<ModuleResult> out) throws Exception {

     private enum ListStrategy { LONG_ELEM_LONG_VOID, LONG_VOID, LONG_TW, GENERIC }
     private final ListStrategy listStrategy;
+    private final PrimitiveLongAccess primitiveAccess;
+    private NativeLongListSnapshot[][] readViews;
+
+    private Iterable<Long> primitiveListView(long key,int group) {
+        long row=primitiveAccess.row(key,group);
+        // One-off reads use a cheap copied array; only repeated reads of the
+        // same version pay for a Cleaner-owned immutable native snapshot.
+        if(row==0 || !PrimitiveLongAccess.cacheListRead(row)) {
+            long[] values=row==0?NativeEngine.listGetLongElements(stateHandle,key,group)
+                    :PrimitiveLongAccess.copyList(row);
+            return values==null?null:new NativeLongListSnapshot(values);
+        }
+        int page=(int)(key>>>8),index=(int)key&255;
+        if(readViews==null)readViews=new NativeLongListSnapshot[1<<16][];
+        NativeLongListSnapshot[] entries=readViews[page];
+        if(entries==null)readViews[page]=entries=new NativeLongListSnapshot[256];
+        NativeLongListSnapshot view=entries[index];
+        if(view!=null && view.keyGroup==group && view.version==PrimitiveLongAccess.read(row+32))return view;
+        view=(NativeLongListSnapshot)NativeEngine.listGetLongView(stateHandle,key,group);
+        entries[index]=view;
+        return view;
+    }
+
+    private void invalidateReadView() {
+        if(readViews==null)return;
+        long key=resolveKeyAsLong(keyContext.currentKey);
+        if(key>=0 && key<(1L<<24)) {
+            NativeLongListSnapshot[] entries=readViews[(int)(key>>>8)];
+            if(entries!=null)entries[(int)key&255]=null;
+        }
+    }
+    private long[] primitiveValues = new long[0];
+
+    private long[] primitiveValues(List<V> values) {
+        if (primitiveValues.length != values.size()) primitiveValues = new long[values.size()];
+        int index=0;
+        for (V value:values) primitiveValues[index++]=(Long)value;
+        return primitiveValues;
+    }

+template <>
+inline LongElementList read_flink_value<LongElementList>(ReadBuffer& buf, const TypeLayout&) {
+    int32_t total_bytes = buf.read_int();
+    if (total_bytes < 4) return {};
+    int32_t count = buf.read_int();
+    LongElementList value; value.reserve(count);
+    for (int32_t i=0;i<count;++i) value.push_back(buf.read_long());
+    return value;
+}

 //  SwissTable
 // ============================================================================
 
+// Swiss H1/H2 need entropy across the entire hash. std::hash of an integer is
+// the identity on libstdc++, which clusters small consecutive keys after H1's >>7.
+template <typename K>
+struct SwissDefaultHash {
+    size_t operator()(const K& key) const {
+        if constexpr (std::is_integral<K>::value && sizeof(K) <= sizeof(uint64_t)) {
+            uint64_t x = static_cast<uint64_t>(key);
+            x ^= x >> 30;
+            x *= UINT64_C(0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9);
+            x ^= x >> 27;
+            x *= UINT64_C(0x94d049bb133111eb);
+            x ^= x >> 31;
+            return static_cast<size_t>(x);
+        } else {
+            return std::hash<K>{}(key);
+        }
+    }
+};
+
 template <typename K, typename V,
-          typename Hash = std::hash<K>,
+          typename Hash = SwissDefaultHash<K>,
           typename KeyEqual = std::equal_to<K>>
 class SwissTable {

+struct ListViewReference {
+    JavaVM* vm;
+    jobject view;
+    ~ListViewReference() {
+        JNIEnv* env=nullptr;
+        if(vm->GetEnv(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&env),JNI_VERSION_1_6)==JNI_OK)
+            env->DeleteGlobalRef(view);
+    }

+JNIEXPORT jobject JNICALL
+Java_org_apache_flink_state_forl0_NativeEngine_listGetLongView(
+        JNIEnv* env,jclass,jlong stateHandle,jlong key,jint keyGroup) {
+    JNI_ENTRY_RETURN(jobject,nullptr,{
+        auto* handle=from_handle<StateHandle>(stateHandle);
+        const auto* values=handle->get_state_table<int64_t,LongElementList>()->get(keyGroup,key);
+        if(!values || values->empty())return nullptr;
+        if(values->read_cache) return env->NewLocalRef(
+                static_cast<ListViewReference*>(values->read_cache.get())->view);
+        // Copy only once per version. The Java owner remains valid after mutation,
+        // state deletion and backend disposal, independently of the state table.
+        auto copy=std::make_unique<std::vector<int64_t>>(values->begin(),values->end());
+        jclass cls=env->FindClass("org/apache/flink/state/forl0/NativeLongListSnapshot");
+        if(!cls)return nullptr;
+        jmethodID ctor=env->GetMethodID(cls,"<init>","(JJJII)V");
+        if(!ctor)return nullptr;
+        jobject view=env->NewObject(cls,ctor,to_handle(copy.get()),to_handle(copy->data()),jlong(values->version),jint(copy->size()),keyGroup);
+        if(!view)return nullptr;
+        // Ownership was transferred to Java's Cleaner by the successful constructor.
+        copy.release();
+        JavaVM* vm=nullptr;env->GetJavaVM(&vm);
+        auto reference=std::make_shared<ListViewReference>();reference->vm=vm;
+        reference->view=env->NewGlobalRef(view);
+        if(!reference->view)return nullptr;
+        values->publish_view(std::move(reference));
+        return view;
+    })

+// A full dense row has no absent slots. Java may access its primitive storage
+// until the table epoch changes; every native mutation invalidates that view.
+JNIEXPORT void JNICALL
+Java_org_apache_flink_state_forl0_NativeEngine_mapLongLongDenseView(
+        JNIEnv* env, jclass, jlong stateHandle, jlong key, jint keyGroup, jlongArray out) {
+    JNI_ENTRY_VOID({
+        auto* handle=from_handle<StateHandle>(stateHandle);
+        auto* table=handle->get_state_table<int64_t,InnerMapLongLong>();
+        jlong view[4]={0,0,
+            static_cast<jlong>(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(table->access_epoch_address())),
+            static_cast<jlong>(table->access_epoch())};
+        if (!table->is_snapshot_active(keyGroup)) {
+            auto* row=table->get(keyGroup,static_cast<int64_t>(key));
+            size_t span=0;
+            auto* data=row?row->full_dense_data(span):nullptr;
+            if (data) {view[0]=static_cast<jlong>(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(data));view[1]=static_cast<jlong>(span);}
+        }
+        env->SetLongArrayRegion(out,0,4,view);
+    })
+}

 using namespace forl0;
 
+
+template<class V> static jlongArray primitive_directory(JNIEnv* env,StateTable<int64_t,V>* table) {
+    auto* d=table->long_directory();if(!d)return nullptr;
+    using Page=typename LongKeyDirectory<V>::Page;
+    const jlong info[]={jlong(d->pages_address()),jlong(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(table->direct_blocked_address())),
+        jlong(d->counts_address()),table->start_key_group(),sizeof(V),offsetof(Page,values),jlong(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(table->access_epoch_address()))};
+    jlongArray arr=env->NewLongArray(7);if(arr)env->SetLongArrayRegion(arr,0,7,info);return arr;
+}
 extern "C" {
 
+JNIEXPORT jlongArray JNICALL
+Java_org_apache_flink_state_forl0_NativeEngine_primitiveLongDirectory(JNIEnv* env,jclass,jlong stateHandle) {
+    JNI_ENTRY_RETURN(jlongArray,nullptr,{
+        auto* h=from_handle<StateHandle>(stateHandle);
+        if(h->key_type!=StateHandle::KeyType::INT64 || h->ns_type!=StateHandle::NsType::VOID_NS || h->hot_cache_ll)return nullptr;
+        if(h->value_type==StateHandle::ValueType::INT64)
+            return primitive_directory(env,h->get_state_table<int64_t,int64_t>());
+        if(h->value_type==StateHandle::ValueType::MAP && h->map_inner_kind==StateHandle::MapInnerKind::LONG_LONG)
+            return primitive_directory(env,h->get_state_table<int64_t,InnerMapLongLong>());
+        if(h->value_type==StateHandle::ValueType::LONG_LIST)
+            return primitive_directory(env,h->get_state_table<int64_t,LongElementList>());
+        return nullptr;
+    })
+}

+TEST(CheckpointRoundTripTest, PackedLongListSnapshot) {
+    StateTable<int64_t, LongElementList> source(0, 1, true);
+    LongElementList list;
+    const std::vector<int64_t> expected{0, 1, -1, INT64_MIN, INT64_MAX, 1000000007};
+    list = expected;
+    source.put(0, 10, std::move(list));
+    source.prepare_snapshot();
+    source.modify_in_place(0, 10, [](LongElementList& v) {
+        v[0] = 99;
+        v.push_back(42);
+    });
+    TypeLayout kl = make_layout(TypeId::INT64);
+    TypeLayout vl = make_list_layout(TypeId::INT64);
+    WriteBuffer buf;
+    CheckpointStateWriter<int64_t, LongElementList> writer(kl, vl, true);
+    size_t count = writer.write_key_group(source, 0, buf);
+    StateTable<int64_t, LongElementList> restored(0, 1, true);
+    ReadBuffer input(buf.data(), buf.size());
+    CheckpointStateReader<int64_t, LongElementList> reader(kl, vl, true);
+    reader.read_entries(input, restored, 0, static_cast<int32_t>(count));
+    const auto* saved = restored.get(0, static_cast<int64_t>(10));
+    ASSERT_NE(saved, nullptr);
+    ASSERT_EQ(saved->size(), expected.size());
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < expected.size(); ++i) ASSERT_EQ((*saved)[i], expected[i]);
+    ASSERT_EQ((*source.get(0, static_cast<int64_t>(10)))[0], 99);
+    ASSERT_EQ(source.get(0, static_cast<int64_t>(10))->size(), 7u);
+    source.release_snapshot();
+}

+TEST(StateTableCOWTest, CachedJniTableSurvivesRegistryGrowthRehashAndSnapshot) {
+    StateEngine engine(0, 1, 128);
+    auto id = engine.register_state<int64_t, int64_t>("count", true);
+    StateHandle handle;
+    handle.state_table = engine.get_raw_state_table(id);
+    auto* table = handle.get_state_table<int64_t, int64_t>();
+    ASSERT_EQ(table, (engine.get_state_table<int64_t, int64_t>(id)));
+    for (int i = 0; i < 256; ++i)
+        engine.register_state<int64_t, double>("other_" + std::to_string(i), true);
+    for (int64_t i = 0; i < 10000; ++i) table->put(0, i, i);
+    ASSERT_EQ(handle.state_table, engine.get_raw_state_table(id));
+    engine.prepare_snapshot();
+    ASSERT_TRUE(table->modify_in_place(0, 42, [](int64_t& v) { v += 7; }));
+    table->put(0, 10001, 99);
+    bool found = false, saw_added = false;
+    table->for_each_snapshot_in_key_group(0, [&](const int64_t& k, const int64_t& v) {
+        if (k == 42) { found = true; ASSERT_EQ(v, 42); }
+        if (k == 10001) saw_added = true;
+    });
+    ASSERT_TRUE(found);
+    ASSERT_FALSE(saw_added);
+    engine.release_snapshot();
+    ASSERT_EQ(*table->get(0, 42), 49);
+    ASSERT_EQ(*(handle.get_state_table<int64_t, int64_t>()->get(0, 10001)), 99);
+}

+TEST(StateTableCOWTest, PagedDirectoryGroupCollisionAndSparseFallback) {
+    CountingAllocator allocator(0);
+    {
+        StateTable<int64_t,int64_t> st(0,2,true,&allocator);
+        st.put(0,9000,90); // Initially outside the admitted dense frontier.
+        st.put(0,-1,7);
+        st.put(1,100,10);
+        for(int64_t k=0;k<10000;++k)if(k!=9000)st.put(0,k,k+1);
+        ASSERT_EQ(*st.get(0,9000),90);
+        ASSERT_EQ(*st.get(0,100),101);
+        ASSERT_EQ(*st.get(1,100),10);
+        st.put(0,9000,91);
+        ASSERT_EQ(st.total_size(),10002u);
+        st.prepare_snapshot();
+        st.remove(0,100);st.put(0,100,999);st.remove(0,9000);st.put(0,9000,999);
+        std::map<int64_t,int64_t> old;
+        st.for_each_snapshot_in_key_group(0,[&](int64_t k,int64_t v){old[k]=v;});
+        ASSERT_EQ(old.size(),10001u);
+        ASSERT_EQ(old[100],101);ASSERT_EQ(old[9000],91);ASSERT_EQ(old[-1],7);
+        ASSERT_EQ(*st.get(1,100),10);
+        st.release_snapshot();
+    }
+    ASSERT_EQ(allocator.used_bytes(),0u);
+}

+TEST(TypedInnerMapTest, DenseRangePreservesGeneralMapSemantics) {
+    InnerMapLongLong m;
+    ASSERT_FALSE(m.is_dense());
+    ASSERT_EQ(m.add_sequence(62, 8, 64, 1), 8);
+    ASSERT_TRUE(m.is_dense());
+    ASSERT_EQ(m.size(), 8u);
+    ASSERT_EQ(m.sum_sequence(-2, 8, 64), 8);
+    m.erase(0);
+    ASSERT_EQ(m.count(0), 0u);
+    ASSERT_EQ(m[0], 0);
+    m[0] = std::numeric_limits<int64_t>::min();
+    ASSERT_EQ(m.find(0)->second, std::numeric_limits<int64_t>::min());
+    auto copy = m;
+    m[-9] = 100;
+    ASSERT_FALSE(m.is_dense());
+    ASSERT_EQ(m[-9], 100);
+    ASSERT_EQ(m[62], 1);
+    ASSERT_EQ(copy.count(-9), 0u);
+    ASSERT_TRUE(copy.is_dense());
+    size_t seen=0; for(const auto& kv:copy) { (void)kv; ++seen; }
+    ASSERT_EQ(seen, copy.size());
+    copy.clear(); ASSERT_TRUE(copy.empty());
+    ASSERT_EQ(copy.add_sequence(0, 4, 64, 1), 4);
+}
+TEST(TypedInnerMapTest, DenseRangeMatchesHashOracleWithWrapAndOverflow) {
+    InnerMapLongLong m;
+    std::unordered_map<int64_t,int64_t> expected;
+    for(int round=0;round<200;++round) {
+        int64_t start=round-100;
+        int64_t delta=round%3-1;
+        int64_t sum=0;
+        for(int i=0;i<97;++i) {
+            int64_t k=(start+i)%64; if(k<0)k+=64;
+            expected[k]+=delta;sum+=expected[k];
+        }
+        ASSERT_EQ(m.add_sequence(start,97,64,delta),sum);
+        for(const auto& kv:expected)ASSERT_EQ(m.find(kv.first)->second,kv.second);
+    }
+    m[0]=std::numeric_limits<int64_t>::max();
+    ASSERT_EQ(m.add_sequence(0,1,64,1),std::numeric_limits<int64_t>::min());
+    m[1000000000L]=9;
+    ASSERT_FALSE(m.is_dense());
+    ASSERT_FALSE(m.enable_dense(64));
+    ASSERT_EQ(m[1000000000L],9);
+}
+TEST(TypedInnerMapTest, DenseRangeCopyOnWriteKeepsOldVector) {
+    StateTable<int64_t,InnerMapLongLong> st(0,1,true);

+    ASSERT_TRUE(st.modify_in_place(0,1,[](InnerMapLongLong& v){v.add_sequence(0,64,64,1);}));
+    int seen=0;
+    st.for_each_snapshot_in_key_group(0,[&](const int64_t&,const InnerMapLongLong& v){
+        ASSERT_EQ(v.sum_sequence(0,64,64),64);++seen;
+    });

+    st.release_snapshot();
+}

+            ListState<Long> list = original.getPartitionedState(
+                    VoidNamespace.INSTANCE, VoidNamespaceSerializer.INSTANCE, descriptor);
+            list.update(Arrays.asList(1_000_000_007L, 2_000_000_014L, Long.MIN_VALUE + 7));
+            java.util.concurrent.RunnableFuture<org.apache.flink.runtime.state.SnapshotResult<
+                    org.apache.flink.runtime.state.KeyedStateHandle>> future = original.snapshot(
+                    1L, 1L, new org.apache.flink.runtime.state.memory.MemCheckpointStreamFactory(1 << 20),
+                    org.apache.flink.runtime.checkpoint.CheckpointOptions.forCheckpointWithDefaultLocation());
+            future.run();
+            handle = future.get().getJobManagerOwnedSnapshot();
+        } finally {
+            original.dispose();
+        }
+        ForL0KeyedStateBackend<Long> restored = buildBackend(false, 0L, Collections.singletonList(handle));

+            restored.setCurrentKey(17L);
+            ListState<Long> list = restored.getPartitionedState(

+            java.util.ArrayList<Long> values = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
+            for (Long value : list.get()) values.add(value);

+            values.clear();
+            for (Long value : list.get()) values.add(value);
+            assertEquals(Arrays.asList(1_000_000_007L, 2_000_000_014L, Long.MIN_VALUE + 7, 3_000_000_021L), values);
+        } finally {
+            restored.dispose();
+            handle.discardState();
+        }

+            backend.setCurrentKey(1L);
